title: Swap @pytest.mark.integration → @pytest.mark.docs in test_p7_3..6.py
objective: Replace the temporary integration-marker substitute on doc-tier tests with the proper docs marker now that it is registered.

plan_assets.asset_description: Follow-up item 14 substitute: P7-3..P7-6 task JSONs carry test_plan.tier: docs but no docs pytest marker. Stubs use @pytest.mark.integration as substitute.

implementation_steps: Grep tests/ for @pytest.mark.integration occurrences in test_p7_3..6
Run uv run pytest -m docs to confirm selection
Run uv run pytest -m "not slow and not gpu" to confirm no regressions
deliverables: uv run pytest -m docs selects exactly the doc-tier tests
acceptance_criteria: No @pytest.mark.integration decorators remain on doc-tier tests in test_p7_* files
uv run pytest -m docs passes selecting only those tests

cases: uv run pytest -m docs selects test_p7_3..6 only (missing)

risks: Marker swap may inadvertently re-tag tests outside the doc-tier scope — mitigation: limit edits to test_p7_3..6 and confirm with grep post-edit

Doc-tier tests previously running under fast-tier integration selector may now be excluded from the fast suite if CI selectors change before P2-3 — mitigation: keep -m "not slow and not gpu and not e2e" inclusive of docs in CI

commands.command: uv run pytest -m "not slow and not gpu" --tb=line -q

completion_notes: Six @pytest.mark.integration decorators swapped to @pytest.mark.docs in test_p7_3.py (2), test_p7_4.py (2), test_p7_5.py (2).
test_p7_6.py had no marker; added @pytest.mark.docs to both test methods and inserted `import pytest`.
uv run pytest -m docs selects exactly 8 nodeids — the 2 tests in each of test_p7_3..6 — and all 8 pass.
